sirs_adults: Respiratory rate above 20/min or PaCO₂ below 32 mmHg.
White cell count below 4 or above 12, or more than 10% immature band forms.
q_sofa_adults: Altered mental status: Glasgow Coma Scale below 15.
Hypotension: systolic blood pressure 100 mmHg or less.
clinical_features.sofa_adults: The source includes the adult SOFA score table for ICU referrals on page 47; no management bundle is printed on pages 46-47.

warnings: SIRS is not specific to sepsis and can occur in trauma, after surgery, burns, pancreatitis and acute inflammatory conditions.
protocol.source_text:
Sepsis + Septic Shock
SIRS = Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome. SIRS is not specific to sepsis. Q-SOFA Adults is a screening tool for undifferentiated patients. SOFA Score Adults is included for ICU referrals.
